Massage
Stress is part of our everyday lives and it affects both our minds and bodies. Massage can release muscle tension, improve circulation, increase joint flexibility and reduce mental and physical fatigue. Do something good for yourself by letting our expert therapists help you refocus on the here and now.

Swedish Massage – General relaxation massage designed to reduce stress, alleviate sore muscles, and induce an overall sense of well-being.

30 Min…………………………………………………………………………………………………………… $40.00

30 Min – Series of 3………………………………………………………………………………………….. $105.00

60 Min…………………………………………………………………………………………………………… $75.00

60 Min – Series of 3…………………………………………………………………………………………. $210.00

90 Min………………………………………………………………………………………………………….. $110.00

 

Hot Stone Massage – Therapeutic stoned are used to enhance the more traditional Swedish massage, either by holding the heated stone while massaging and/or placing the stones in specific places on the body.  This massage is based on the ancient traditions of Chinese medicine to help relax and heal the mind, body and soul.

60 Min…………………………………………………………………………………………………………… $80.00

60 Min – Series of 3…………………………………………………………………………………………. $225.00

 

Deep Tissue Massage – A corrective and therapeutic massage technique that focuses on the deeper layers of the muscle. This massage will help to release tension, remove toxins, and soothe the muscles.

60 Min…………………………………………………………………………………………………………… $90.00

 

Reflexology – An ancient art of massage based on the principles that there are reflexes in the hands, feet and ears that correspond to every part, organ and gland in the body thereby improving circulation, detoxification, reduced tension and aide’s in the body’s ability to heal itself.  This treatment method can be effective for back pain, migraines, arthritis, and many other problems.

60 Min…………………………………………………………………………………………………………… $75.00

60 Min – Series of 3…………………………………………………………………………………………. $210.00

 

Shiatsu Massage – This massage consists of a finger-pressure technique that concentrates on unblocking the flow of life energy (or chi) and restoring the balance in the various meridians on the body.  When these meridians are unblocked, the major body systems and organs they represent are encouraged to heal and attain perfect balance.

90 Min………………………………………………………………………………………………………… $100.00

90 Min – Series of 3…………………………………………………………………………………………. $270.00

 

Prenatal Massage – Pregnancy is a time when major changes occur in the body. Massage therapy can help by aiding in better sleep, loosening tight muscles, relieving back, pelvic and ankle pain, reducing swelling, alleviating headaches, and sinus congestion and boosting energy.

60 Min…………………………………………………………………………………………………………… $80.00

 

Chair Massage – Stay fully clothed and feel relief from pain and tension in the head, neck, shoulders, back, arms and hands.

Per Min…………………………………………………………………………………………………………… $1.00
